rules: No magic. A small inland research station in Antarctica, the present day, on the last day of the summer season.
The last aircraft leaves at four in the afternoon; after it, nobody arrives or leaves for eight months.
The aircraft can take one more load of ninety kilograms: one person or the crate of ice cores, never both.
The station leader signs the manifest; headquarters may overrule her by radio until the engines start.
The core freezer's compressor is failing; nobody expects the cores left in it to last the winter.

locations.name: The Galley
locations.description: The warm heart of the station: a long table, a coffee urn, the season's photographs on the wall, a window onto the white.

locations.name: The Radio Room
locations.description: A cramped desk of handsets and a flight screen; the only line to headquarters.

locations.name: The Clinic
locations.description: One bed, a locked drug cabinet and a heart monitor; a paper trace is pinned above the desk.

locations.name: The Core Store
locations.description: A freezer container at minus thirty, racks of silver tubes, and a compressor that knocks, stops and starts again.

locations.name: The Skiway
locations.description: A groomed strip of snow where the red aircraft waits, its pilot pacing beside the fuel drums.

characters.name: Priya
characters.public: The station leader and its only doctor, fifty, calm, in her third season here; her signature goes on the manifest.
characters.voice: Quiet and clinical; asks one question at a time and waits.
goals: Put Aroha on the plane before a winter tests the heart her trace shows
Bring her whole winter crew through to spring

secrets.text: At dawn headquarters radioed her that next season's funding depends on the cores flying today; she has passed it on to no one. [SECRET-PRIYA-K9]

characters.name: Aroha
characters.public: A glaciologist of thirty-seven from New Zealand, in her third season; the ice cores in the store are her life's work.
characters.voice: Warm, quick and funny; serious only about the ice.
goals: Get the core crate onto the plane
Stay the winter herself to drill again in spring

secrets.text: She has fainted twice this month alone in the drill tent and told no one; the lost hours are the gaps in her drill log. [SECRET-AROHA-F4]

characters.name: Tomás
characters.public: The station mechanic, forty-one, from Chile, who keeps the generators and the freezer alive; his wife is expecting their first child within the month.
characters.voice: Dry and practical; swears in Spanish and explains by fixing.
goals: Take the last place himself and be home for his daughter's birth

secrets.text: The freezer can last the winter after all, but only with an improvised fix he alone knows and the relay in his pocket; if he flies, the cores left behind will thaw. [SECRET-TOMAS-2C]

arc.premise: On the last day of the Antarctic summer, the one free place on the last plane out is wanted by a doctor for her patient, a scientist for her ice, and a mechanic for himself.

chapters.goal: When the engines start at four, the last load is aboard, and a hidden fact has changed what someone asks for.
